SELECT t.id AS "id", t.kind AS "kind", t.tx_date AS "txDate", t.client_name AS "clientName", t.subject_id AS "subjectId", t.amount AS "amount", t.method AS "method", t.bank_account_id AS "bankAccountId", t.card_id AS "cardId", t.note AS "note", t.created_by AS "createdBy", s.code AS "subjectCode", s.name AS "subjectName", s.category AS "subjectCategory", b.bank_name AS "bankName", b.account_no AS "accountNo", c.issuer AS "cardIssuer", c.last4 AS "cardLast4" FROM acc_transaction t LEFT JOIN acc_subject s ON s.id = t.subject_id LEFT JOIN acc_bank_account b ON b.id = t.bank_account_id LEFT JOIN acc_card c ON c.id = t.card_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND t.kind = #{kind} AND t.tx_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
AND t.client_name ILIKE '%' || #{clientName} || '%' ORDER BY t.tx_date, t.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acc_subject WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO acc_transaction (kind, tx_date, client_name, subject_id, amount, method, bank_account_id, card_id, note, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{kind}, #{txDate}, #{clientName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{subjectId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{amount}, #{method}, #{bankAccountId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{cardId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{note, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{now})
